title: The Core Verbs
label: ch:mr-core-verbs
canDo: I can use six everyday Marathi verbs, pick the present-tense ending that agrees with my subject's gender, end every sentence on the verb, and say that I know something the way Marathi says it — with the knower in the dative and आहे closing the line.

payoff.summary: Say मला माहीत आहे and मला मराठी येते unprompted: the knower in the dative, the verb agreeing with its own subject rather than with the speaker, and आहे closing the sentence — the whole chapter's machinery in two lines.
